=====================================================
FOLIA CODEX — FUTURE CULTIVARS (PROSPECTIVE SPECIES)
=====================================================
This is a plain text file. Open and edit it with Notepad, TextEdit, or
any text editor — no coding required.

This file is for entirely speculative, not-yet-real species — your own
hypothetical "what might exist someday" ideas, grounded in a real
research trend or theory (climate adaptation, gene editing, newly
discovered extremophile plants, whatever). Unlike field-notes.txt, this
isn't describing an existing Pokémon — you're proposing something new.

Every entry below is a DUMMY PLACEHOLDER until you replace it. Cards with
no real content render as a "?" mystery card in the app automatically —
you don't need to delete unfinished entries, just leave fields as "???"
and they'll display as unrevealed.

HOW TO ADD ONE:
1. Copy the TEMPLATE block below and paste it anywhere in this file.
2. Change "template" on the first line to a short unique id (lowercase,
   no spaces — e.g. "cultivar-001").
3. Fill in whatever fields you have. Leave any field as "???" if you
   haven't decided yet — that's expected, not an error.
4. Save the file. Refresh the app in your browser to see it appear.
=====================================================

### TEMPLATE   [PLACEHOLDER]
working_title: ???
concept: ???
research_basis: ???
status: Hypothesis stage
notes: ???
### END

### END

### END
